So we need to copy research_notes.txt to archives/2024_research_backup.txt. Then maybe move the copy? But copying already creates a copy. The phrase "moving a copy" might mean copy then move? But we can just copy to archives with new name. Let's do cd to research, then cp research_notes.txt to archives/2024_research_backup.txt? But cp expects source and destination names without paths. We can't specify path. So we need to cd into archives then cp research_notes.txt to 2024_research_backup.txt. That will copy the file into archives with new name. That satisfies requirement. Let's do that.
